title: CPSC, Century Announce Recall of Multi-Use Strollers
summary: The strollers can unexpectedly collapse or the car seat/carrier adapter can unexpectedly detach. When this happens, an infant or young child inside the stroller or an attached car seat/carrier can fall to the ground and suffer serious injuries. Units: About 650,000.

title: CPSC, KB Toys Announce Recall of Activity Gym Toys
summary: Five detachable hanging rattle toys have small round pegs at the top of the toys that can break off, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 115,000.

title: CPSC, Battat Incorporated Announce Recall of Beanbag Cushions Suffocation and Strangulation Hazards to Babies Cited
summary: This product is an infant cushion manufactured by Battat for Parents™ magazine. Infant pillows and cushions have been banned under the Federal Hazardous Substances Act since 1992 because they pose a suffocation hazard to infants. title: CPSC, BRIO® Announce Recall of Toy Baking Sets
summary: The sets include a hand mixer with a knob that can break off, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: 6,450.

title: CPSC, Gymboree Announce Recall of Baby Boy Bodysuits
summary: The wheel-shaped zipper pull can twist off and become a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 5,500.

title: CPSC, Hedstrom® Corp. Announce Recall of Swings on Backyard Gym Sets
summary: Screws that hold the swing together can fall out, causing the seat to fall to the ground, posing an injury risk to children. Units: About 190,000.

title: CPSC, Five Firms Announce Recall of Backpack Blowers
summary: The fuel tanks on these blowers can leak, posing a fire hazard and risk of burn injuries to consumers. Units: About 50,500.

title: CPSC, Firms Announce Recall of Chain Saws and Child Table Seats
summary: A missing screw can cause the chain brake to fail to operate, presenting a laceration hazard to consumers. The seats were sold without a seat belt, posing a risk to children who climb out of the seat. Units: About 1,000 chain saws and 780 child table seats.

title: CPSC, Firms Announce Recall of Remote Controlled Toy Race Cars and Galileo Weather Thermometers
